praise: Specific, credible copy end to end — real address (Hwy 99, Lynnwood), 4.9/141 reviews, concrete services, quotes-before-work framing; zero filler language.
Tight two-accent palette (navy + orange/gold) that actually suits a motorsports shop, used with discipline instead of gradient soup.
Type pairing is right: Archivo Black display vs Archivo body, clamped hero scale holds up at 360px, tagline line-length is comfortable.
One-visit test passes easily: name, offer, phone, and address are above the scroll and repeated consistently.
